outcome: Approved local eager-logging aliases/comments implemented; scoped checks pass; independent final acceptance remains ARRC-06

commands.label: typecheck
commands.includes: fresh access-router and necessary transitive builds, then tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.typecheck.json

focused.selection: Exactly the three logging suites, all-16-mode CRUD harness and four deterministic-work suites; no full package run
focused.all16ModeTuples: Unchanged 434-test CRUD harness passed: 432 catalog cases and two guards, including READ fallback and both UPSERT branches

identity.algorithm: SHA-256(JSON.stringify([relativePath,fileSHA256][])); recursive readdir name.localeCompare('en'), same as maintained CRUD filesUnder; no node_modules

mechanicalReview.algorithm: Parse pre/post service with createSourceFile at the same path. Require exactly two unexported aliases with AST types identical to the original extra annotations; remove only those alias nodes and expand only those two parameter type references. Compare complete normalized AST trees by SyntaxKind and leaf text, excluding JSDoc/trivia/positions. Compare both method bodies directly, exact debugLog object-literal/as-expression bytes, all other class-member text and class header/member order. Independently reconstruct the complete candidate from six exact approved text substitutions. Transpile the full source before/after with target ESNext, module ESNext/CommonJS, removeComments true, sourceMap/declaration false; require byte-identical JavaScript outputs and no parse/transpile errors.
mechanicalReview.preserved: Exact executable expressions/casts, receiver dispatch, clock/summary/model-name/extra-read ordering, caller argument evaluation and eager level/logger resolution; logger-helpers and OpLogContext untouched; metadata factory and populate bindings/comments retained

workComparison.limits: 128 fresh records match the durable ARRC-01 observations exactly; no duplicate rows archived. These are deterministic work diagnostics, not timing/allocation measurements or a performance claim. Unrelated publication observations were not rerun.

preservation.manualAudit: Strict JSON, relative links/baseline references, private path/session patterns, whitespace, git diff --check, protected hashes and declaration bytes checked before handoff
preservation.auditHarnessCorrection: The first audit helper incorrectly required exit 0 from git diff --no-index --check for new files; Git returned 1 with no diagnostics. Corrected the helper to accept 0/1 only with empty stdout/stderr, then reran. No source, test or contract change was needed.
preservation.omitted: Operational source snapshot, AST/emission/check/runner scripts, full command logs and Vitest assertion JSON, duplicate work rows, source/declaration byte copies, dependencies, generated builds and MongoDB files. Scratch is disposable, not a portable reproduction bundle; reconstruction needs the baseline revision plus retained ARRC-02/03 changes, workspace dependencies/toolchain and memory-server prerequisites.

notRun: full package test (ARRC-06 owns one final run)
root/grouped/downstream tests or root build/lint sweep
ARRC-05/06 implementation or independent final acceptance
